feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: International news, global reporting and analysis from NPR. Plus dispatches from NPR’s State of the World podcast.

entry.title: Trump is in Asia ahead of Xi, Putin summit. And, tech leaders want Huang back at Nvidia
entry.summary: Trump says he plans to discuss Ukraine during his Asia trip, which contradicts what the White House previously announced. And, Silicon Valley leaders are pushing for Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia.

entry.title: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip
entry.summary: Manila is President Trump's first stop on a three-day trip that will later take him to China for historic three-way nuclear talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

entry.title: Ukraine strikes major Russian bridge with drones and missiles as aerial attacks escalate
entry.summary: A Ukrainian drone and missile attack prepared over several weeks struck a vital Russian rail and road bridge to the occupied Crimean Peninsula, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Tuesday.

entry.title: Trump to meet Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin for joint summit
entry.summary: President Trump is off for a series of meetings in Asia that will cover trade, security and a rare trilateral meeting with China and Russia.

entry.title: Africa: Trading in yuan
entry.summary: The dollar has long ruled Africa's financial landscape. But as more countries turn to China's yuan, the balance of economic power could be shifting.

entry.title: U.N. talks seek to rein in 'killer robots' as fears over AI weapons grow
entry.summary: Countries are meeting in Geneva to negotiate rules on weapons that can select and kill targets without human intervention. But with the U.S., Russia and Israel resisting legally binding controls, campaigners fear the window to act is closing.

entry.title: FAA ground stop still affecting thousands of flights. And, Trump meets Xi, Putin in Asia
entry.summary: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said that things could be back to normal at the end of Monday after an FAA ground stop disrupted flights. And, Trump heads to Asia for a high-profile trilateral summit.

entry.title: Chris Van Hollen says he can beat Chuck Schumer. Here's his case
entry.summary: Sen. Chris Van Hollen told NPR's Morning Edition why he believes he can defeat Sen. Chuck Schumer and what he would change about Senate Democratic leadership.

entry.title: Trump heads to Asia to meet with Xi and Putin amid Nvidia fallout
entry.summary: The trip to China marks Trump's second time this year, and comes as the president and his party faced widespread backlash from voters in the recent midterm elections.

entry.title: What to expect from Trump and Xi's upcoming meeting in China
entry.summary: Preview of what to expect as President Trump meets with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China this week.
